summary: Measure the character length of stored text.
documentation: For text, SQLite length counts Unicode code points before any zero character, rather than UTF-8 bytes. NULL input produces NULL. Blob input instead measures bytes.
inputs: A text, blob or numeric expression.
returns: A length integer, or NULL for NULL input.
caution: Code points are not always visible characters: a combining mark can add to the count without appearing as a separate symbol.
scenarios: Check whether product labels fit a display field.
Find unusually long imported reference values.
Summarize text lengths before changing a form limit.
title: Measure product label lengths
problem: From labels(id INTEGER, name TEXT), return id and length(name) as characters for every row, ordered by id. Preserve NULL lengths. Test strings contain no embedded zero characters.
goal: Use length() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Select the id beside length(name), with an explicit alias.
